process.title: Walkthrough & feasibility
process.text: We visit the property, measure, and check zoning, utilities and structure so there are no surprises later.

process.title: Design & engineering
process.text: Layout, 3D renderings and finish direction, coordinated with structural engineers where the design needs it.

process.title: Permits & written scope
process.text: We handle plan check and permits. Your contract lists the scope, named allowances, and what is excluded.

process.title: Build & closeout
process.text: Scheduled trades, inspections passed, a clean site each day, and a final walkthrough before sign-off.

privacy: When you send a request through this site, we collect the details you enter (name, phone, email, property address, project details and any photos) so we can respond and prepare an estimate. We don't sell your information or share it with anyone except the engineers, designers or trades we need to involve in your project, and only with your knowledge. To see or delete what we hold about you, email info@dreamhavenconstruction.com.
